title: Spyglass: Out of Beta and Ready for You!
summary: We're thrilled to announce the official launch of Spyglass, moving beyond beta to provide everyone with an intuitive new way to gain valuable insights.

title: Advanced File Management & Display
summary: We've launched a robust set of tools that empower you to effortlessly upload, manage, and customize the display of all your files directly within the editor.

title: Introducing Our New Public Roadmap
summary: Explore our new public roadmap page for a transparent look at recently released features, upcoming developments, and exciting future plans.

title: Seamless Checkbox Interaction
summary: Experience a smoother workflow with our newly enhanced checkboxes, now easier to click, fully draggable, and beautifully integrated with our modern design.

title: Enhanced Collaboration Experience
summary: Enjoy a more fluid and intuitive collaborative workspace with clearer insights into shared activities and real-time updates.

title: Enhanced Sharing and Collaboration
summary: Now you can effortlessly find and collaborate on all relevant shared content, empowering seamless teamwork and idea exchange.

title: Unlock Global Language Support
summary: Expand your reach and enhance user experience with comprehensive support for a wide array of international languages, making Noeko truly global.

title: Noeko: Now Open Source!
summary: We are open-sourcing Noeko to give you greater control, foster community collaboration, and provide complete transparency into our development.

title: Dynamic Constellation View
summary: Explore your knowledge like never before with an enhanced Constellation view, featuring powerful new filters by tags and time, alongside insights into your shared items and connections.

title: Precision Search & Curated Collections
summary: Effortlessly pinpoint exact information with powerful new filtering and sorting capabilities, allowing you to save and revisit personalized knowledge collections with ease.

title: Smarter Linked Notes
summary: We're introducing more flexible and interactive ways to display linked content directly within your notes, making it easier to organize information and reflect your thought process.

title: Noeko's Official Launch with Flexible Hosting
summary: Get ready for Noeko's official launch, bringing you the freedom to choose between self-hosting for complete control or convenient cloud plans designed to meet your needs.

title: Elevate Your Experience with Stunning New Themes
summary: Get ready for a refreshed aesthetic as we enhance our current themes and introduce exciting new options for a more personalized look and feel.

title: Perfectly Timed Greetings
summary: Experience perfectly accurate greetings tailored to the exact time of your day, making your homepage feel even more welcoming.

title: Streamlined Tag Management
summary: Easily remove multiple items from a tag directly from the tag view, saving you time and effort.

title: Connect More of Your Knowledge
summary: Seamlessly import and interact with a diverse array of content, including videos, websites, and text files, to centralize all your essential information in one place.
